The execution failed due to incorrect margin calculations and missing comma formatting in the final markdown summary.
Calculated panel values (369.2 vs 6276.4) and total 14-day margins (26185.96 vs 1090.76) showed massive discrepancies, likely due to errors in contract row selection or active_labs resolution. The summary markdown failed validation because values like '26185.96' lacked the required comma separators for thousands. Potential logic errors include date-based contract sorting and the handling of run frequency (14-day vs 28-day).
